Now, the white square (rows 34-43, cols 27-36) still has a diagonal purple fill remaining. The piece is directly above the white square (piece's bottom edge is row 31, square's top edge is row 34, with a 2-row gap).
Now I'll press SPACE and check the fill pattern in the 0° orientation.
